realReviews.author: John
realReviews.text: We had the pleasure of having Dave and Levi re-point our roof and not only was it done professionally, but Dave also went to great lengths to check that both the roof and sark were in great condition. We would highly recommend Dave and Levi for any renewal or maintenance to your tiled roof. Dave has a great persona and pride in his work.

realReviews.author: Mark Rickards
realReviews.text: We had an old tiled roof with broken pointing and other problems. Dave and his crew stripped it down, conducted repairs, re-pointed the ridges and valleys. It is practically new again and will last another 30 years. Thanks Dave for a professional job.

finalCta.headline: Is your tiled roof due for some work?
finalCta.body: Send a few photos or pick a time for Dave to come out. You'll get a written quote before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just honest advice about your roof.

faq.q: How do I know if my roof needs repointing?
faq.a: Cracked or crumbling mortar on the ridges, loose ridge caps or leaks near the ridge line are common signs. Send a photo and we'll tell you.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs?
faq.a: Yes. No job too big or small, from a few broken tiles to a full roof renewal.
Yes. Roof cleaning is part of the work, on its own or before repointing.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to Dave, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a look at the roof.
